pages.comparisonText: Pipe Tour (2023) recording comparison Archived tour WR: 1:17.90 · newyork Six recovered leaders begin with Tankian’s final fastest first-day result, 1:19.40. newyork’s final 1:17.90 video was published July 17 at 14:35 UTC, before its 14:47 submission. The first screenshot is unavailable; a matching later resubmission original and the movie are preserved.
